ground_truth.title: Michigan's Most Trusted Pest Control
ground_truth.main_content:
BTR Pest Control is a licensed, eco-friendly pest control company in Livonia, Michigan, serving over 200 cities across 5 counties with a 4.9-star rating and 90-day warranty.

Our Pest Control Services

BTR Pest Control offers general pest control, bed bug treatment, rodent control, wildlife removal, carpenter ant treatment, cockroach extermination, flea treatment, stinging insect removal, and mole control.

General Pest Control

Interior Only $209

Exterior Only $209

Interior/Exterior $229

Int/Ext + Flying Insects $255

Ext + Flying Insects $229

Prevents: Spiders, Pavement Ants, Box Elders, Stink Bugs, Centipedes, Millipedes, Beetles, Silverfish, Paper Wasps, Rollie Pollies, Mud Dabbers, Lady Bugs, House Flies, Pantry Pests, Carpet Beetles, and Clover Mites

90-Day Warranty

Seasonal Package

$550

Comes with 3 visits throughout the year, eliminating general pests. First visit is an interior/exterior to eliminate any insect on the inside of the home also treating the exterior to put a barrier up around the home. 2nd treatment is an exterior treatment 3 months later, to keep the barrier up around the home. The 3rd visit is 3 months after the 2nd to keep the barrier up all year long. Additional discounts are given to our seasonal customers for services not covered in the seasonal package.

Year-round Warranty

Carpenter Ant Treatment

$255

Interior/exterior treatment to eliminate Carpenter ants. The chemical we use on the exterior has a transferring effect. It gets attached to the ants, they bring it back to the colony, contaminating the food source, killing the queen. The carpenter ant treatment comes with a 90 day warranty.

90-day Warranty

Bed Bug Treatment

Starting at
$399

Base price for homes under 4,000sqft includes all the baseboards, empty dresser draws, empty side tables draws and one bed or couch treated. Additional beds and couches are $99 each. The 2nd treatment price is half the price of the 1st treatment. Everyone will have to leave the house for 4-6 hours to let the chemical dry. Prep work is required before the treatment.

2nd Treatment 50% Off

Cockroach Treatment

Starting at
$239

Interior treatment of homes under 4000sqft includes all the baseboards, kitchen, bathroom and laundry room cabinets treated. The 2nd treatment price is half the price of the 1st treatment. Everyone will have to leave the house for 4-6 hours to let the chemical dry. Prep work is required before the treatment.

2nd Treatment 50% Off

Flea Treatment

Starting at
$275

Interior treatment of homes under 4000sqft includes broadcast spray all the floors, 3 ft up the baseboards, under and the sides of upholstered furniture, box springs, rugs and pet beds treated. The 2nd treatment price is half the price of the 1st treatment. Everyone will have to leave the house for 4-6 hours to let the chemical dry. Prep work is required before the treatment.

2nd Treatment 50% Off

Why Choose BTR Pest Control?

Bee Treated Right - Every Time

90-Day Warranty

We ask that you wait 30 days for all pests to interact with the chemical. If you are still seeing pests after 30 days we will come back and do a retreat. *Bed bugs, exterior rodent setups and wildlife removals do not have a 90 day warranty.

Eco-Friendly Solutions

The chemicals we use are stain-less, odor-less, and EPA approved. We always avoid treating pollinating plants to help the bees and butterflies.

Same-Day Service

Emergency pest problems? We're available daily from 9am-8pm for rapid response.

Licensed & Insured

Fully licensed Michigan pest control professionals with comprehensive insurance for your peace of mind.

Community Coaches

Owners Chris and his wife are Redford Wrestling coaches, and team member Chris Brown coaches Redford Union Basketball. We're invested in our community on and off the field.

Ready to Eliminate Pests for Good?

Call BTR Pest Control at 734-338-1828 for same-day pest control service across Southeast Michigan. Free quotes available.
